body:
This was my first experience with bath salts. Word of caution first. Always engage in harm reduction practices to avoid harm to you or others. If I do happen to be testing a substance on which is currently no or conflicting data I always start with lower dosage than what is considered active dosage by lowest source and slowly work my way up. There is no need to hurry.
T+0:00 I took about 200mg of ephylone powder about a third intranasally and the rest orally. The taste is really disgusting.
T+0:30 It really kicked fast but euphoria which was present was really overwhelmed by stimulation. It was still controllable but time already.
T:+0:45 I arrived at bar and I suddenly felt the urge to talk to everyone and to say anything. But I wasnt in good environment for this.
I think that for therapeutic use I need higher. This drug could be considered the drug of truth but there should be also lower dosage than recreational, because the substance makes hard for subject to concentrate on one thing and to think straight.
T+10:00 it was really fun way to try new things and to meet new people but it got really annoying because nobody could keep with me and the more I want to help people the more they are annoyed.
T+12:00 empathy and love start to wear off but the mental stimulation was at its peak. It was really kind of breakthrough where I just suddenly get it all and I want to share it with everyone but I cant formulate anything that makes even common sense.
T+14:00 I really want to go sleep so I take about 2 grams of phenibut repeatedly to counter the stimulating effect but even weed would not make me fall asleep.
T+24:00 I am sitting at train station. Effects have mostly worn off and I am in full control now. Also I dont bother people anymore if I want someone I try not to annoy people who are at work because they already get annoyed to people who are just really annoying.
So some recap right now: I really achieved opposite of what I wanted to I didnt make any friends but I had really amazing and unique experience.
